livermorium.detector: SHREC implantation detector; CAEN VX2740 digitizers
livermorium.digitizer_limit: Paper states up to 125 MS/s; actual timestamp resolution is not supplied.

events.event: first escape-like alpha assigned to Lv-290
events.text_witness: EVR-like event followed 5.66 ms later by a 0.60(1)-MeV

events.event: first full-energy alpha assigned to Lv-290
events.text_witness: MeV EVR followed 17.3 ms later by a recoil-corrected

livermorium.selection: Both published Lv-290 chains in Gates et al. 2024 Figure 2, without selecting by agreement with a model.
livermorium.selection_conditions: EVR 10<E<30 MeV, at least one full-energy alpha and subsequent spontaneous fission in the same pixel within one second of implantation.
livermorium.transport: Evaporation residues selected by Berkeley Gas-filled Separator before implantation. Formation time is not the recorded origin.
